rationale.text: A form holds two visible select elements, and each optgroup in them carries a label attribute. The test asks whether each optgroup in each select has a label attribute, and the methodology validates it when that holds for every optgroup. The custom check answers no_fault (step 6 for every optgroup), so the finding is passed at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only. Whether the labels are relevant is test 11.8.3.

citations.quote: Dans chaque balise `<select>`, chaque balise `<optgroup>` possède-t-elle un attribut `label` ?
Pour chaque élément `<optgroup>`, vérifier qu’il possède un attribut `label` ;
Si c’est le cas pour chaque élément `<optgroup>`, **le test est validé**.
